base_bullets.bullet: Built an object detection system using YOLOv8 and rasterio to process GeoTIFF drone images with sliding-window tiling.
Designed and scaled backend microservices using FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Redis caching for real-time notifications.
Fine-tuned Llama 3 8B model using LoRA and PyTorch for domain-specific text classification and automated summarization.
Implemented high-throughput data pipelines with DSA optimization, Pandas, and NumPy for quantitative risk assessment.
